about: The /boss onboarding form, the one source for the skill (AskUserQuestion: at most 4 questions per call, 4 options each, Other always offered) and bin/boss-init (--questions, --answers). It asks at most four questions in one call (three after the first two are already set on this machine), then the expectations as an open question in chat; every other setting is derived (derive_only: never asked, listed as unset when nothing answers) or keeps its default, and changes later with `bosskit.py config set`. A question whose value is already set above the kit defaults is skipped (`onboard questions --all` asks everything). Answering is the consent: `bosskit.py onboard apply <answers.json> --apply` writes without a further prompt and prints one summary. An id the form no longer has is ignored, with a note. Per question: id (the answers file's key), key (the dotted config key it sets; a list sets each), level (where its value lands unless a level is named), derive (a path into `bosskit.py detect`: when it gives a value, the question is not asked), free (asked as a plain question, no options), options [{label, value, description}] (value "$default" is the kit default; an option's value may be a list, and its sets {key: value} sets several keys; an answer is a label, a value or Other text, which is JSON when it parses), and multiSelect options add up.

questions.question: What should be posted on the PR? Check any, all or none. To choose none, leave every box unchecked, or pick Other and type none.

options.label: Status note
options.description: A worker's one short plain-English done or blocked note, with the proof links, ending with the hidden marker the watcher reads

options.label: Demo video
options.description: The recorded demo, attached to the PR

options.label: Review replies
options.description: Workers reply on the PR's review threads themselves

options.label: Boss notes
options.description: The boss posts what it verified when it marks the PR ready, and a short note after it merges

questions.question: Which host plugin runs your workers?
What should the project be called? (A short name; it is the folder under $BOSS_HOME.)
What is the base branch PRs target?

options.label: main
options.description: The usual default

options.label: master
options.description: Older repos

questions.question: What is your GitHub login? (Only your PRs are the boss's to sync and push.)
Where should proof and review pages go? (A provider of your own: Other, as JSON {"provider", "publish"}.)

options.label: Auto
options.description: The host's pages, else a claude.ai artifact

options.label: Host
options.description: Always the host's pages

options.label: Artifact
options.description: Always a claude.ai artifact

questions.question: When a worker's PR is merged and its worktree is clean, should the boss ask before archiving it?

options.label: Ask each time
options.description: Ask in the next message, one block per workspace

options.label: Archive, then tell me
options.description: A standing OK; it still asks for research workspaces and leftovers

options.label: Short, action first
options.description: Your next action first, then URGENT / NEXT / CAN WAIT, in the fewest lines

options.label: Detailed
options.description: Action first, with reasons and evidence for each item

options.label: Voice
options.description: Plain sentences, no tables or symbols

questions.question: Is this the project's main boss, or a domain boss that owns one area of it?

options.label: Main boss
options.description: Covers every folder

options.label: Domain boss
options.description: Owns one area; you name it next

questions.question: What proof does UI work owe?

options.label: Demo
options.description: A recorded demo, mandatory for UI-heavy work

options.label: Screenshots
options.description: Screenshots of each step on a page are enough

questions.question: Should mail from another boss also message this boss's session (wake it)?

options.label: No
options.description: Mail waits in the inbox; every prompt names it. Mail sent --urgent still wakes an idle session

options.label: Yes
options.description: One fixed line lands in the session, naming only the kind and the sender's project, never the subject or body

followups.question: What is the domain's name? (Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. It owns the sidebar folder of that name; say so if the folder differs.)
Which sidebar folder does this domain boss own? (Enter keeps the domain name.)

fixed: Merging: the boss never merges, closes a PR or pushes to the base branch without your OK in the conversation. That is fixed, not a setting.

expectations.heading: ## Expectations
expectations.question: What are your expectations of me as the boss of your project?

defaults_note: Everything else keeps its default; change any of it later with `bosskit.py config set --level project KEY=VALUE` (see `bosskit.py config show`).
closing: I'm a mere boss but you are the god. I hope to please you and get things done. Always let me know how I can be better.
